name: Stick Draw
description: Draw with sticks and circles in the editor. Pick any editor object for them.

stick-object-id.name: Stick object ID
stick-object-id.description: Object used for the sticks. Easier: select an object in the editor and press 'Stick = selected' in the tab.

circle-object-id.name: Circle object ID
circle-object-id.description: Object used for the circles (joints). Easier: select an object in the editor and press 'Circle = selected' in the tab.

stick-thickness.name: Stick thickness
stick-thickness.description: Thickness of sticks in game units.

circle-diameter.name: Circle diameter
circle-diameter.description: Diameter of circles in game units.

snap-radius.name: Snap radius
snap-radius.description: If you start/end a stick this close to an existing circle, it connects to that circle instead of making a new one.

drag-threshold.name: Drag threshold (screen px)
drag-threshold.description: How far you must drag before it counts as a stick instead of a click that places a circle.
